{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module Main where

import Control.Concurrent (forkIO, MVar, newMVar, readMVar, modifyMVar_)
import Control.Monad (forever, forM_)
import qualified Data.ByteString as BS
import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as C8
import qualified Data.Text as T
import qualified Data.Text.Encoding as TE
import Data.Word (Word8)
import Network.WebSockets as WS
import Data.Char (chr, ord)

type ClientList = MVar [(WS.Connection, T.Text)]

-- Reverse proxy forwards X-Forwarded-User header as first frame
-- Server uses this for authentication context

main :: IO ()
main = do
    clients <- newMVar []
    WS.runServer "0.0.0.0" 9160 (app clients)

app :: ClientList -> WS.ServerApp
app clients pending = do
    conn <- WS.acceptRequest pending
    WS.withPingThread conn 30 (return ()) $ do
        -- First frame from proxy contains auth header
        authFrame <- WS.receiveData conn :: IO BS.ByteString
        let username = decodeProxyHeader authFrame
        case validateUsername username of
            Nothing -> WS.sendClose conn ("Invalid auth" :: T.Text)
            Just validName -> do
                modifyMVar_ clients (\cs -> return ((conn, validName) : cs))
                handleMessages clients conn validName

-- Decode the proxy header using strict UTF-8 decoding
-- Rejects any malformed or overlong sequences
decodeProxyHeader :: BS.ByteString -> T.Text
decodeProxyHeader bs = 
    case TE.decodeUtf8' bs of
        Right t -> t
        Left _  -> T.empty

import qualified Data.Bits

-- Username validation: only allows alphanumeric and underscore
validateUsername :: T.Text -> Maybe T.Text
validateUsername t
    | T.null t = Nothing
    | T.length t > 32 = Nothing
    | T.all (\c -> c >= 'a' && c <= 'z' || c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z' || 
                   c >= '0' && c <= '9' || c == '_') t = Just t
    | otherwise = Nothing

-- Sanitize message content before broadcast
sanitizeMessage :: T.Text -> T.Text
sanitizeMessage = T.filter (\c -> c /= '\0' && c >= ' ' && c <= '~')

-- Command parsing for admin functions
data Command = Kick T.Text | Ban T.Text | Broadcast T.Text | Regular T.Text

parseCommand :: T.Text -> T.Text -> Command
parseCommand username msg
    | username == "admin" && "/kick " `T.isPrefixOf` msg = Kick (T.drop 6 msg)
    | username == "admin" && "/ban " `T.isPrefixOf` msg = Ban (T.drop 5 msg)
    | username == "admin" && "/broadcast " `T.isPrefixOf` msg = Broadcast (T.drop 11 msg)
    | otherwise = Regular msg

handleMessages :: ClientList -> WS.Connection -> T.Text -> IO ()
handleMessages clients conn username = forever $ do
    rawMsg <- WS.receiveData conn :: IO T.Text
    let sanitized = sanitizeMessage rawMsg
    case parseCommand username sanitized of
        Kick target -> do
            cs <- readMVar clients
            forM_ cs $ \(c, u) ->
                if u == target then WS.sendClose c ("Kicked" :: T.Text) else return ()
        Ban target -> do
            modifyMVar_ clients (\cs -> return $ filter (\(_, u) -> u /= target) cs)
        Broadcast content -> do
            cs <- readMVar clients
            forM_ cs $ \(c, _) -> WS.sendTextData c ("[SYSTEM] " <> content)
        Regular content -> do
            cs <- readMVar clients
            let formatted = username <> ": " <> content
            forM_ cs $ \(c, _) -> WS.sendTextData c formatted
